headline: Asian Physical LNG Deliveries Hit Record 148.5 TBtu in August MOC
summary: Physical deliveries concluded under Platts Asia LNG Market on Close assessment reached a record 148.5 TBtu in August. The milestone surpassed the previous record of 113 TBtu set a month earlier.
why: Platts Asia LNG assessments provide pricing references for liquefied natural gas spot trading across Asian utility markets.

impacts.name: LNG Asia Spot
impacts.why: Record trading delivery volumes signal high physical liquidity in regional gas markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
